features.description: Prescribe shared canonical STATUS/log headings at Gate 4 writing step, explain delayed archive ratchet failure, document self-check and repair, qualify legacy World example, mirror both copies and add one changelog fragment.
acceptance_criteria: Execution changes only the two gate-4-record.md resource copies and changelogs/unreleased/2026-10-16-gate4-status-stamp-shape.md, with about 8-20 added lines per copy, byte-identical mirrors and a fragment beginning ### Fixed — . No routing, lane order, quota/ration thresholds, billing guards, CI workflows, SKILL.md, Go code, tests, charters or other resource changes.

At the STATUS update step prescribe literally ## STATUS <YYYY-MM-DD> — ITERATION <n>: <headline> for every mission, citing internal/mission/normalize.go canonicalStatusRe as authoritative over prose. Require EM DASH U+2014 with single spaces, upper-case ITERATION, colon directly after number and non-space headline; forbid COMPLETE/DONE before colon, date parentheses and lower-case iteration. Include one-line canonicalEntryRe log companion ## <n> — <YYYY-MM-DD> — <title>.

Explain delayed failure: charters are not linted, so a wrong stamp passes silently until rotation into *-mission-status-archive.md makes TestMissionDocHeadingsStayCanonical ratchet red, usually in a LATER iteration. Include focused canonical test, one-line grep of actual new stamp, dry-run ailang mission normalize then --apply repair, and optional charter-local notes under the shared rule. Preserve World casing war story, qualifying its form as non-canonical legacy.

The plan Perl check fills placeholders from the edited prescription and extracts canonicalStatusRe from production source: ## STATUS 2026-10-16 — ITERATION 44: x matches and the documented ## STATUS 2026-10-16 — ITERATION 44 COMPLETE: x does not. Run against both copies; output shape MATCH; forbidden NO MATCH, rc 0.

make check-skills, make check-context-docs, make check-referenced-paths, make check-changelog, make check-file-sizes, make check-doc-review, make check-no-personal-email and make check-tmpfile-hygiene return rc 0 on edited tree; cmp copies rc 0; go test ./internal/mission/ -run Canonical -count=1 and full go test ./internal/mission/ -count=1 have actual rc 0 evidence. Socket-bound full package needs outside-sandbox controller verification. Base-red gates are findings, not workarounds.

Independent evaluator runs four disposable text mutations: prescribed em dash to hyphen, COMPLETE before colon, dropped normalize.go/canonicalStatusRe reference, dropped rotation/ratchet WHY. Plan grep commands must each give original count 1 rc 0 and mutant count 0 rc 1; no persistent test files.

Controller rehearses an actual charter-to-status-archive rotation for each named live mission v1/docs/motoko/fleet/triage in a disposable snapshot, keeps newest three, proves moved-heading destination presence and charter arithmetic/content preservation, and runs focused and full mission tests rc 0 after each rotation. World cross-repo evidence is added if in live inventory; remains unverified here. No rehearsal artifacts in delivery diff.

CONTROLLER ONLY outside sandbox: env -i HOME=$HOME PATH=$PATH USER=$USER TMPDIR=$TMPDIR make test-launchd-drivers rc 0. Any network/socket/gh-dependent sandbox check is UNINFORMATIVE UNDER SANDBOX, never pass or fail. Missing controller evidence remains pending.

Controller actual iteration-44 Gate-4 record uses canonical shape and passes go test ./internal/mission/ -run Canonical -count=1 after recording/rotation. Independent sprint-evaluator acceptance is required; executor must not edit charters to supply controller evidence.
